findings.reason: False positive. The address flagged is the JustEvery organisation's repository list filtered to its run- seeds (the /orgs/ route, the organisation name, then /repositories?q=run-), linked as 'Browse the repos'. The scanner reads the route word and the organisation name as an owner and repository; GitHub reserves that route word, so no such repository can exist. The address answered 200 without sign-in on 26 Oct 2026, and no other spelling shows the same filtered list: the organisation overview ignores the query and ?tab=repositories redirects to the overview.

False positive in the version of this file from commit 0f211c88, kept in history; the next commit spells each address out. That version built every coming-soon seed's address from a template that appends the seed's slug to the organisation's run- prefix, and the scanner reads the prefix before the placeholder as a repository. All 14 addresses the template produced name public repositories (checked through the GitHub API on 26 Oct 2026), and the rewritten file produces the same 14 addresses.
